judgment.notes: n is uniquely the integer λ+1, not an assumed positive dimension. Positivity and cardinality are exported by N001; no hypothesis is hidden in this definition.

I is the finite integer interval [0,λ], including the singleton {0} when λ=0. Membership supplies nonnegative indices for factorials and binomials; no nonemptiness is assumed by the set definition. N001 supplies its cardinality and nonemptiness under H003.

X_r is defined on V over ℂ for each nonnegative integer r by the action power divided by r!, with X_0 the identity. These factorials are nonzero finite products in ℂ. No reduction or lattice preservation is assumed; those properties occur separately in N001, N002 and N005.

Y_r is the complex action power y^r/r! for nonnegative r and has the specified identity at r=0. The division is in characteristic zero, not in K. Lattice preservation, termination and reduced formulas are proved/exported rather than included as definitional properties.

U_Z is precisely the ℤ-subalgebra generated by the two divided-power families in the stated universal enveloping algebra, with the action determined by the given representation. This agrees with the problem and supplies no PBW or integral-form theorem. Stability of M is the explicit H006, used in R002, not a property smuggled into the algebra definition.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
